title: Lune - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Lune in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Who They Are
sections.content:
Lune is the party's healer and its elemental setup. She applies Burn and other elemental Stains that other characters then build their damage around.

Joins: Start

sections.title: Background
sections.content: (not documented in verifiable sources) published backstory detail.

sections.title: Playable or NPC
sections.content:
Their defining mechanic is Elemental Stains.

Party role: Mage / Healer.

Skills, Pictos and stat allocation are covered on the Lune build guide - this page is the character, not the kit.

In the party tier list they sit at A.
